title: GTA+
headline: GTA+
subtitle: This Month’s Benefits
content:
In addition to the recurring monthly GTA$500,000 deposited directly into your Maze Bank account, GTA+ Members who've signed up for this month (October 8–November 4) will also receive:

— The Pegassi Oppressor (Motorcycle)
— The MTL Brickade 6x6 and Acid Lab Supplies
— The Ride or Die Chore Jacket and Ride or Die Jeans
— 50% off Alien Weapons at the Gun Van
— 6X GTA$ & RP on Survivals
— And more

Membership automatically renews monthly, cancel anytime. Visit rsg.ms/gtaplus for more info.
